text:
Alex: Heads-up: late window 02:00-03:00 UTC. We need a coordinated handover for release v2.14.0 across API/runtime/Console/Router. I'll kick the deploybot when everyone ack's.
Taylor: on console - I can hold UI rollout until runtime signals green. Need the hashlock on console config so routing swaps atomically.
Maria: runtime can pin model-runtime v2.14.0 on staging -> prod. Will prepare KV cache warmup and prefetch. ETA 20m.
Sam: router team: we can steer traffic slices 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m. Need canary header + no-eviction flag set.
Kei: SRE: gating: if p95 latency > 150ms for 5m or 5xx rate > 1.5% we rollback. Also watch KV evictions and OOMs.
Alex: DeployBot: please create hashlock and reservation for runtime+router+console
DeployBot: @Alex deploy request created: id deploy-7141592653, services=[api,runtime,console,router], version=v2.14.0, window=2026-03-23T02:00Z..2026-03-23T03:00Z :rocket:
Taylor: Confirmed. Console will block feature flags until canary ok.
Maria: runtime preflight logs:
```
ok: model load v2.14.0
prefetch: warm caches 12 shards
kv_hits: 98%
```
Sam: Router preflight: canary rule ready, env var ROUTE_LOCK=hash-7141592653
Kei: running smoke: `curl -sS -H 'x-release: canary' https://api.redwood.test/health` -> 200 OK
Alex: going to start with 5% slice now. I'll trigger deploybot canary. If no objections say :thumbsup:
Taylor: :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Kei: :eyes: monitoring dashboards, I have alerts pinned.
DeployBot: canary started: deploy-7141592653 step=canary slice=5% -> timestamp 7141592680
Alex: can we keep console logs verbose for 10m? Need to catch structured failures.
Taylor: setting log level=debug for console routes.
Kei: p95 spike to 168ms at T+7m, but error rate 0.4% - continuing to 25% as agreed.
Maria: runtime reports small GC spike, no OOMs. KV eviction rate stable.
Alex: moving to 25% now.
DeployBot: rollout progress: slice=25% -> timestamp 7141592700
Sam: router saw one backend 502 during 25% ramp, traced to api v2.14.0 timeout 1.2s - pushing increased timeout to 1.5s for canary.
Alex: thumbs-up, make the timeout change and re-evaluate.
Sam: timeout change applied.
Kei: after timeout tweak p95 back down to 145ms, error rate 0.7% - continuing.
Alex: moving to 100% in 10m unless anyone calls rollback.
Maria: warming complete, caches steady.
Taylor: releasing console flags incrementally, UI gated to 50% users first.
Kei: reminder: Rollback triggers: p95 > 200ms sustained 5m OR 5xx > 1.5% - I will initiate rollback if triggered.
Sam: noted. I have a quick rollback plan to shift traffic back at router level and unpin runtime.
Alex: thanks all. Final notes: add release notes to docs repo after warmup. I'll close the handover when metrics stable.
Taylor: copying release-note draft after window.
DeployBot: rollout complete: deploy-7141592653 status=complete timestamp 7141592720 :tada:
Alex: :rocket: great job everyone. Postmortem: none needed unless alerts trip. Closing thread.
